# meshmsg v0.1.18

This release delivers a major production-readiness hardening pass for mesh messaging, local APIs, retries, downloads, and attachment storage. Broader work remains, including observability, fuzz/load coverage, toolchain pinning, and signed release provenance/SBOMs.

## Security and reliability

- Introduces topic-bound EnvelopeV2 broadcasts with signed message IDs, freshness checks, bounded replay protection, and transport/per-sender/global admission limits.
- Bounds local IPC connections, frames, queues, and command lifetimes; shutdown now drains tracked handlers and overload returns structured errors.
- Makes downloads transactionally durable with verified pinning, synchronized no-clobber installation, explicit partial-success metadata, restart reconciliation, and crash-boundary coverage.
- Adds reusable operation IDs and bounded idempotent mutation caching for broadcast send, private send, and attachment share, including concurrent request joining and changed-input conflict detection.
- Persists direct-message replay state in a checksummed WAL/snapshot with conservative crash recovery, bounded capacity/rates, and durable duplicate classification without storing message bodies.
- Adds strict attachment remove/prune lifecycle operations, byte/pin quotas, minimum-free-space enforcement, bounded startup reconciliation, and race-safe in-flight GC protection.
- Versions and strictly validates IPC, HTTP, SSE, error, and benchmark contracts. Benchmark send schema v2 now has complete scheduler/submission accounting, overflow-safe metric validation, feasible missing-sequence samples, and correlated partial outcomes.

## Web experience

- Unifies text messages and attachment sharing in one composer with file selection, removable file details, drag-and-drop, and one Send action while preserving selections after rejected or uncertain outcomes.
- Fixes a shutdown signal race so Ctrl+C cannot be lost when another web-server event becomes ready at the same time.

## Compatibility

This release is intentionally fail-closed and is not wire/API compatible with older running components. EnvelopeV2 peers do not downgrade to legacy topic-unbound broadcasts, legacy signed attachment tokens are rejected, and mutation/typed IPC calls require the advertised current capabilities and exact schemas. Upgrade and restart all meshmsg peers, daemons, CLI clients, and web processes together. Benchmark send consumers must accept schema version 2.

Sender retry guarantees remain bounded and memory-only: daemon restart, cache expiry, or eviction ends mutation-result replay. Delivery acknowledgements are still not provided.

Install this exact source release:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.18 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.17...v0.1.18
